GITHUB_APP_ID.description: GitHub App ID (numeric, top of the App settings page). One of the three inputs the use-time helper (lib/git-credential-github-app) mints ~1h installation tokens from. Human-supplied — deliberately no source: the mint:github-app resolver arm stays RESERVED for the #252 per-bot sidecar, because a boot-time resolver would put 1h tokens at rest in the launch env.

GITHUB_APP_INSTALLATION_ID.description: GitHub App installation ID for the org/account this fleet commits to. Without it the JWT exchange has no target, so it is secret under the authenticate-without test even though the value itself is not confidential.

GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH.description: Path to the App private-key .pem on this host (the key file itself must be 0600 and is never composed anywhere). lib/setup-github-app.sh validates all three values end to end and prints these lines for the fleet .env.
